Container.Name: spamfilter-unbound
Container.Overview: Recursive DNS resolver for the IMAP spam filter stack. Lets rspamd run DNSBL queries (Spamhaus, Abusix, SpamCop) without hitting the rate-limits that public/shared resolvers impose. Required for the RBL module to actually contribute signal.
Container.Requires: Custom network `spamnet` must exist: `docker network create spamnet`.
